title: The Earth's pull and weight (পৃথিবীর টান ও ওজন)
placement: Book page 79, topic 3.7: মহাকর্ষ বল, beside the second half of the page, the Earth's pull on a body on its surface (F = GMm/R², g = GM/R², R from the Earth's centre).
description: The Earth's pull and weight (page 79, topic 3.7), one scene: the Earth cut open like an orange to its centre (inner core, outer core, mantle, crust; Dhaka at the top) in a starry sky, with an iron 1 kg bazaar weight drawn very much bigger than life. One big button in two steps: put the weight on the ground (two equal outlined violet arrows: its weight, about 9.8 N, and its pull on the Earth; R drawn from the Earth's centre), then a second weight on top (twice the weight, the same 9.8 N for each kg: g = GM/R², with the book's values). One result line, one rule. Test tab: 3 tap questions (does the weight pull the Earth, R for a weight 1 m up, the weight two radii from the centre). The two iron spheres on a bench are the lab law-of-gravitation. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
